meta.goal: rebase a feature branch onto main with git and resolve the conflicts

lesson.title: Git Rebase and Conflict Resolution
lesson.goal: rebase a feature branch onto main with git and resolve the conflicts

steps.title: Rebase feature branch onto main
steps.instructions: Make sure you are on the feature/login branch and run git rebase main. Git pauses on the first conflicting commit.

explanations.topic: Why git rebase replays commits onto the new base
How conflicts pause a rebase per commit

hints: Which branch are you currently on before running the rebase?
Pass the target branch name main to git rebase.
Run git rebase main in the terminal.
common_mistakes: Running git rebase feature/login while on main instead of rebasing from feature/login onto main.
Rebasing commits that have already been pushed to a shared remote branch.

steps.title: Inspect rebase status in terminal
steps.instructions: Run git status to check the active rebase state and identify which files have unmerged conflicts.

targets.caption: Verify the conflicted file in Unmerged paths

explanations.topic: Reading rebase progress in git status

hints: Use a standard Git inspection command to see the current repository state.
Run git status to view remaining commits and unmerged paths.
common_mistakes: Trying to run git commit during a paused rebase instead of checking git status first.

steps.title: Resolve merge conflicts in index.js
steps.instructions: Open index.js, keep DEFAULT_USER set to "admin" plus both the /profile and /login routes, and remove all conflict markers.

explanations.topic: Resolving conflict markers manually in the editor

hints: Look for the <<<<<<< HEAD markers inside index.js.
There are two conflicted sections in index.js: DEFAULT_USER and the routes/middleware block.
Set DEFAULT_USER to "admin", keep both the /profile route and the /login route, and delete all <<<<<<<, =======, and >>>>>>> lines.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to scroll down to the second conflict block in index.js and leaving conflict markers behind.
Accidentally deleting the /profile route from main instead of keeping both routes.

steps.title: Stage the resolved index.js file
steps.instructions: Stage index.js using git add and run git status to confirm all conflicts for this commit are resolved.

explanations.topic: Staging conflicted files to mark resolution

hints: How do you tell Git that a conflicted file has been resolved?
Run git add index.js and check with git status.
common_mistakes: Running git rebase --continue before staging the edited file with git add.

steps.title: Continue rebase and save commit message
steps.instructions: Run git rebase --continue, then press Escape and type :wq in Vim to keep the commit message and proceed to the next commit.

targets.caption: Continue the rebase after staging index.js

explanations.topic: Using git rebase --continue instead of git commit
Why the middle commit applied without conflicts

hints: Do not run git commit during a rebase; use the rebase continue flag.
When Vim opens with the commit message, press Escape, type :wq, and press Enter.
Run git rebase --continue and exit Vim with :wq.
common_mistakes: Running git commit instead of git rebase --continue.
Typing :wq directly in Vim insert mode instead of pressing Escape first.

steps.title: Resolve merge conflict in package.json
steps.instructions: Open package.json and accept the incoming "check" script change so it runs "node --check index.js", removing all conflict markers.

explanations.topic: Resolving the final commit conflict in package.json

hints: Open package.json and locate the conflict in the scripts object.
common_mistakes: Leaving a trailing comma or invalid JSON syntax when removing conflict markers in package.json.

steps.title: Stage package.json and finish rebase
steps.instructions: Stage package.json with git add, run git rebase --continue, and save the commit message in Vim using :wq.

targets.caption: Stage package.json and finish the rebase

hints: Stage package.json just like you staged index.js earlier.
Run git add package.json, then git rebase --continue, and exit Vim with :wq.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to save package.json before running git add package.json.

steps.title: Verify rebase completion with git status
steps.instructions: Run git status to confirm you are on feature/login with a clean working tree and no active rebase.
hints: Check the repository status one last time.
Run git status to confirm you are no longer in a rebasing state.
common_mistakes: Assuming the rebase finished without checking git status for remaining unmerged paths or detached HEAD.
